value: Arabic text never gets letter-spacing, uppercase transforms or monospace (V12 rule kept).
Arabic line-height ≥ 1.6 for body text (the guide's 1.2 ratios clip diacritics).
Latin runs inside Arabic (codes, e-mails, URLs) are isolated with <bdi> or dir=ltr spans and carry lang=en.
Digits stay Western (0–9) as in V12; dates '27 أكتوبر 2026، 10:15 ص' — 12-hour clock with ص/م, no time-zone label (owner decision).
Use logical CSS properties (margin-inline-start, padding-inline, border-inline-start, text-align:start) so one stylesheet serves RTL and LTR.
Directional icons (arrows/chevrons) mirror; progress symbols, logos and numbers never mirror.

value: Icons are decorative (alt="" / aria-hidden) and never the only carrier of meaning; every icon sits next to a text label.
Progress states use text glyphs (✔ ● ○ ⏸ ↩ ✕ ⚠ — ◇) plus words, not icons, so they survive image blocking and plain text.
The guide's 50 % opacity applies to decorative KPI icons only; meaningful glyphs use full-opacity ink (≥ 3:1).
Directional icons mirror in RTL (arrow-left in Arabic CTAs, arrow-right in English).
